issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962. Close the loop the parent's acceptance asks for, without destroying existing pins.

- Run scripts/build-from-archive.sh twice for a pinned sha from pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md that has a recorded binary (e.g. f25ab5c91c09a3408f23b9cdf2f3e95e81abc060), with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH taken from the commit's committer date. Confirm both runs produce the identical sha256, proving the pipeline is reproducible.
- Do NOT overwrite the existing pinned-binaries/bead-* binaries: their recorded hashes predate deterministic builds and remain verify-by-hash-only. Keep the fresh binary out of the repo (leave it in ~/scratch or under an explicitly untracked name), and record only sha256 + metadata in the closing note. Before committing any new multi-MB binary, check the Forgejo pre-receive blob cap — origin push on this repo is already blocked by historical blobs, so adding more makes it worse.
- Re-assert the child regression test: git stash list and git reflog unchanged across both runs.
- Read-only inventory: capture `git stash list` (the 17 pre-existing entries) for the operator. Never drop or pop them.

Acceptance:
- Closing note records: the sha built, both identical sha256 values, the fresh binary's `--version` string, the script invocation used, and the 17 stash entries verbatim.
- git stash list and git reflog are byte-identical before and after the whole validation.
- No existing pinned binary or .metadata.json in pinned-binaries/ was modified (verify with git status).

issue.description:
ADR-002 replaces cross-tool migration with agent-guided rehydration whose deliverable is a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording the source repository and commit, and explicitly not accepted as native store input. No format for that report is specified anywhere in the docs. Define a versioned report shape, document it alongside the field guide, and add tests for the behaviors ADR-002 names as required for large repositories: duplicate detection across source items and resumable/batched reconciliation. Include round-trip guidance ensuring the report can never be consumed as native store input.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Specify and test the agent-guided rehydration reconciliation report (ADR-002)
